profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Innovative and well-rounded software developer with strong analytical skills and specialized development experience with front-end web development using AngularJS/Angular framework and other libraries (Knockout) and also desktop/mobile app development with XAML frameworks (UWP, WPF).

positions.title: Software Engineer (CEBES)
positions.description:
Developing, testing and maintaining CST (Commercial Services Tool) web portal composed of a front end and back end service which many CSS/ASMS support engineers and PayOps agents use to view and edit customer billing accounts, subscriptions, assets and invoices. This portal is written for the Modern Billing API (MCAPI) platform, integrates with more than 30+ partner services and 170+ partner APIs and runs on Azure platform.

Designed, implemented and tested EAC (Early Adoption Credit) balance controller/service/repository layers and batch table service layer that allows surfacing of EAC state/audit/event processing data from Azure Table Storage and the support of EAC balance debit/credit transactions stored in CosmosDB database helping to maintain an accurate balance of applied credit through user interactions including: Uplift, Refund, Return, RI Return, Revert, Add Quantity and Remove Quantity. This EAC process helps onboard JEDI clients to Azure platform by reverting their marketplace discounts on eligible target products before applying early adoption credit to their purchase's selected line items to avoid double discounting.

Coordinated between two other co-workers to split workload for building out new EV2(ARM) templates, creating new CDPx build pipelines and release pipelines on Azure DevOps for different azure platform environments (Global, Aircapi, Fairfax, USNat and USSec) and then deploying to these environments for both CST Microservices (Inflow/Kredito web services with latest EAC functionality) and CreditReporting service ensuring Microsoft will be able to meet the requirements of the JEDI contract by providing these dependencies.

Technologies: C#, Unity, ASP.NET Web API, .NET framework 4.7.2, Azure SQL, Azure CosmosDB, AAD, Azure Table Storage, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Web Jobs, Azure Functions, AngularJS, Angular, TypeScript, SASS, MVC, Web Components, XUnit, Moq, Visual Studio 2019, Git, Azure DevOps, ARM/EV2 templates, CDPx, NuGet, SCRUM, GDPR

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II, Cloud Design Studio (HITS)
positions.description:
Developing, testing and maintaining the HITS website that many internal researchers use to write their own report studies on various research materials allowing other consumers of HITS to search for important factual information and to follow recommendations for courses of action.

Providing study report editing capabilities for internal research and UX design research teams (Cloud Design Studio, Xbox Research, Cosine, Customer Insights Research, LinkedIn, Evoke, Edge, WDG DEP Data Science, M365 Team, OXO Research, Project Delaware, C+AI Accessibility, Power Platform, C+AI Developer Relations Design UX etc.) allowing them to provide key insights and feedback relating to topics and studies of their own importance and making it discoverable to the entire Microsoft company.

Designed and implemented external service and business service layer APIs, which interact with SharePoint Online through SharePoint Client Side Object Model (CSOM) library, allowing consumers to interact with the document library to create folders, upload office documents, publish documents and manage user/group permissions. This enables HITS to integrate office documents into the web application and maintain a place to store them on the SharePoint Team Site.

Designed and Implemented co-auth locking capabilities, supported by a new EntityLock EF repository, lock business service layer and lock web API layer, to ensure different page sections of a report are locked for editing preventing other users to edit until the user navigates away to release the locks.

Technologies: C#, Unity, ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Web API, .NET framework 4.6.1, Entity Framework 6, SQL Server/Azure SQL, AAD, Azure Search, Azure Redis Cache, Web Jobs, CSOM, Knockout, tinyMCE, WebCore, Bootstrap, Office UI Fabric, TypeScript, JavaScript, MVVM, MVC, Components, MSTest, Moq, Visual Studio 2017, Git, TFS, VSTS, NuGet, Agile, SCRUM

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II, Studios Quality (GNS)
positions.description:
Developed, tested and maintained the Phoenix LOB application (C#/XAML/WPF) that many testers in the Studios Quality organization depends on to test different game titles allowing their titles to be ready to ship to production.

Provide developer support of the Phoenix LOB application for 1st party Microsoft studio game partners (Forgotten Empires, Turn10 Studios, Vanguard Games, Mojang, The Coalition, Reagent Games, Moon Studios, 343 Industries, Undead Labs etc.) allowing them to more effectively develop games for the Xbox One XDK, PC and mobile platforms. These partners are known for their released titles such as: Age of Empires, Forza, Minecraft, Gears of War, Crackdown, Halo, State of Decay, Ori and the Blind Forest etc.

Added new enhanced accessibility and custom validation support for the query data grid user control that Phoenix's Nautilus module depends on for creating filters used for game telemetry.

Designed and developed a new dialog manager that abstracted away a lot of the Prism framework's interaction request MVVM dialog implementations down to one simple method call to show either notification dialogs, confirmation dialogs, toast notifications and flyouts. 

Designed and developed a map visualizer control that would enable users to interact with map units via mouse selection (drag select, group selection, single selection), zoom in/out of the map, rotate or pan the map and supports converting points between canvas/world coordinates taking into account the world's lowest and highest points, the up axis and left/right handedness. 

Provide updated documentation for Phoenix LOB application on an internal Phoenix wiki site for newly implemented functionality.

Technologies: C#, XAML, WPF, Prism, MEF, .NET framework 4.6.1, MVVM, Visual Studio 2017, Git, VSTS, Nuget, Agile, SCRUM

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
Developed, tested and maintained an existing e-commerce marketplace website for a multi-level marketing company Vision Global. 
 
Designed and developed REST endpoints on our shopping services API utilizing C#/ServiceStack technologies in order to integrate and send orders to an online fulfillment and shipment site known as ShipStation. This allowed our fulfillment center AWS to quickly ship purchased products to Vision Global customers. 

Designed and developed a user interface on our website which provided a way to send password reset messages to Vision Global customers either by email via Postmark API or by text via Twilio C#/.NET SDK. 

Technologies: C#, ASP.NET MVC, ServiceStack, REST, IIS, SQL Server, Transact-SQL, .NET framework 4.5, CSS3, HTML5, JavaScript, jQuery, Bootstrap, Twilio C#/.NET SDK, Postmark API, Visual Studio 2017, Agile

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II, XBOX Live Media Support (ATG)
positions.description:
Developed, tested and maintained all active ATG LOB internal web applications used by the ATG team including the new ATG Dash BI Analytics web app for monitoring the state of unanswered, unassigned and top Xbox Live forums questions among other statistics.

Designed, developed and shipped REST WebApi web services to production for the new ATG Dash BI Analytics website (SQL Server/C#/ASP.NET WebApi).

Collaborated with MSN Apps team in developing, testing and deploying their Weather UWP app onto the Xbox One platform ensuring a successful delivery to the Xbox Store by their target date in September 2016.

Architected, designed and developed a VSIX package that provides a tool window for developers to customize their own means of deployment to multiple Xbox One consoles for all Xbox One XDK ERA applications.

Architected, designed and developed a VSIX package that provides a menu to automatically generate the necessary mapping file based off the current project for use in building app packages for Xbox One ADK applications.

Assisted and supported partners in migrating old Xbox One ADK Apps to Windows 10 UWP apps targeting Xbox One platform.

Provided developer support for 1st and 3rd party media application partners (Netflix, Hulu, HBO, Showtime, Sling, Twitch, Starz, Youtube etc.) developing media applications for the Xbox One and 360 consoles.

Provided developer support for 1st and 3rd party game partners (Disney, Ubisoft, EA, Motiga, Activision, Bungie, Bandai Namcom, Konami, Rockstar etc.) developing games for the Xbox One console.

Technologies: C#, XAML, WPF, C++/CX, WinJS, XboxJS, WinRT, UWP, Windows Store Apps (8, 8.1, 10),  HLS, Adaptive Smooth Streaming, MPEG-DASH, PlayReady, ASP.NET Web API, CSS3, HTML5, JavaScript, jQuery, Angular, Bootstrap, TypeScript, SASS, ChartJS, Visual Studio 2015, TFS, VSO, Git, Kanban

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
Successfully ensured efficient on time delivery of Microsoft's new Enterprise Cloud website, allowing maximum exposure to public audiences, providing them access to information about Microsoft's cloud services.

Created interactive web pages utilizing front-end technologies such as HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and jQuery,

Integrated and transformed back-end XML data sources with XSLT rendering them with ASP.NET Web Forms for display on a high profile front-end facing public website.

Added responsive web design to support varying display devices to include mobile devices, tablets and desktop environments.

Technologies: C#, ASP.NET Web Forms, SQL Server, Transact-SQL, .NET framework 4.5, CSS3, HTML5, JavaScript, jQuery, Visual Studio 2012, IIS, Agile, SCRUM

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description:
Ensured over 96 servers and 1500 workstations maintained current software patches and anti-virus definitions.

Monitored and maintained 96 servers, 10 Alcatel switches and a Cisco router for any system abnormalities minimizing impact to availability of company resources.

Maintained the daily backup of 96 servers providing an ability to recover the loss of any critical resources during system or equipment failures.

Upgraded a majority of company servers to Window Server 2003, SQL Server 2005, ISA Server 2004 and Exchange 2003 while bringing them into a virtual environment.
